review.count: Exactly six complete Clawd interaction poses, generated independently of jumping core row.
review.identity: Terracotta no-outline body, four individually separated short legs in every pose, no mouth, two black square eyes wholly within body.
pose_order: picked up, arms tucked inward, upward attentive eyes, four hanging legs
held, arms remain tucked, four hanging legs lengthen gently
tossed right, eyes as a pair move toward screen-right inside forehead, arms open, four legs hang
airborne rightward continuation with downward body settling and rightward eyes
compressed landing with four planted feet, square eyes forward
review.spacing: Six separated connected groups, no clipped limbs or detached effects; no human hand, string, props, symbols or shadows.
review.motion_notes: First two poses intentionally reduce arm span while keeping torso width comparable to resting. Landing pose intentionally squashes body. Runtime should provide actual carried/tossed position and velocity; source is pose set, not a complete physics demonstration.

required_final_processing: Extract by actual component bounds with one common body scale; do not individually enlarge narrower picked-up silhouettes to fill cell width.
Register held and airborne poses by common torso/interaction anchor; retain hanging-leg and landing squash geometry.
Quantize slight source grain and remove magenta fringe with binary alpha cleanup.
Inspect native-size transitions and actual desktop carried/tossed/landing runtime behavior before accepting.
